u.0.1.31.2.s: LYNX SHARE 0.1.31.2 fixes a start page crash, the typing keyboard over docked plugins, stretched clips that looped their first bar, automation lanes made from FL projects and two smaller issues.
u.0.1.31.2.f0: Scrolling the start page's "Start a new project" list no longer crashes LYNX on Windows.
u.0.1.31.2.f1: Over a docked plugin the typing keyboard plays first again when the window's keyboard button says so, as in a detached window.
u.0.1.31.2.f2: With "Stretched pattern clips loop their pattern" on, notes drawn, pasted or moved past a clip's first bar are heard: the pattern grows to hold them.
u.0.1.31.2.f3: Playlist › "Move automation clips into their tracks' lanes" keeps the values the clips played, also on big FL projects.
u.0.1.31.2.f4: "Manage shortcuts" opens with the caret in its search box on Linux desktops that activate windows late (#244); Options › Typing keyboard settings opens the Root note / Octave / Layout menu on any window size (#270).
